message.content:
With 2 crews at Palangkaraya you reach 15 of 105 P1 fires and visit 22 clusters for 649.9 risk covered, up 2 P1, 2 clusters and 87.1 risk on today. Second Palangkaraya crew visits C7 then C6.

You still miss worst P1: C13 near Kualapesaguan, West Kalimantan, C12 near Sungaitulak, West Kalimantan, C8 near Bassiri, Central Kalimantan, C19 near Bawang, Central Kalimantan, C9 near Kanamit, Central Kalimantan.

Visiting is not extinguishing. Assumes bases at capitals, 10.0 hour day, 30.0 km per hour, 2.0 hours on site.
